ns2:course.label: Special Topics
ns2:course.description: Special topics in subject areas within the College of Fine and Applied Arts intended to augment the existing curriculum. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated for a maximum of 8 credit hours in separate terms if topics vary.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated for a maximum of 8 credit hours in separate terms if topics vary.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
